recipes.title: Where to restart road wildlife monitoring
recipes.decision: Choose a small set of previously surveyed road sections for renewed monitoring before spending on mitigation or camera deployment.
questions: Where should we restart roadkill monitoring?
Which road sections were repeatedly dangerous for mammals?
Where should I put a few cameras to check present road-crossing risk?

required_inputs.description: Dated 2011 roadkill records on repeatedly surveyed routes.
Dated 2012 roadkill records retained only for hindcast evaluation.
Route visits, route length and sampled road habitat points.

product.observed: Earlier roadkill points, surveyed road cells and withheld later roadkill points.
product.modelled: An effort-adjusted historical risk ranking learned only from the earlier year.
product.decision_output: A budget-sized set of road cells for renewed monitoring, emitted only when the hindcast passes.

validation.method: Fit effort-adjusted cell rates from the 2011 monsoon surveys and test their ranking against the withheld 2012 summer surveys.
validation.claim_if_passed: The highlighted sections retained predictive signal one year later and are defensible places to begin a present-day validation survey.
validation.claim_if_failed: Show the historical observations but do not recommend priority sections.

invocation.agent_rule: Invoke after the user identifies road wildlife, roadkill, crossings or a limited monitoring budget. Explain that the test is historical and present-day mitigation still requires a renewed survey.

limitations: The survey records roadkill, not successful crossings or animal abundance.
A passed 2011 monsoon-to-2012 summer hindcast does not establish current 2026 risk.
Road-cell effort is allocated from each route's sampled habitat points rather than a continuous GPS effort trace.
Recommendations remain on the routes represented by the admitted survey.

recipes.title: Where another forest-recovery visit will add the most knowledge
recipes.decision: Prioritise a limited resurvey of existing plots where adult forest structure least reliably predicts regeneration recovery.
questions: Which restoration plots should we revisit first?
Where does regeneration differ from what the adult trees would lead us to expect?
With money for ten plots, where will another survey improve the recovery model most?

required_inputs.description: Comparable 0.04 ha plot measurements of regenerating tree richness.

required_inputs.role: predictors available at resurvey planning time
required_inputs.description: Adult tree structure, canopy cover and distance to protected forest from the same fixed plots.
Named landscapes withheld together so neighbouring plots cannot leak into validation.

product.observed: Measured adult and regeneration indicators at fixed plots.
product.modelled: A transparent nearest-neighbour estimate evaluated with whole-landscape holdouts.
product.decision_output: Existing plots with the largest honest held-out errors, spread across landscapes, for targeted remeasurement.

validation.method: Withhold every plot from one named landscape, choose the neighbour count using a second whole-landscape validation inside the remaining data, estimate the untouched landscape, and compare against a training-mean baseline.
validation.claim_if_passed: The model generalises better than the baseline across held-out landscapes; its largest errors identify useful resurvey locations, not restoration failures.
validation.claim_if_failed: Retain the measured plot map but do not turn prediction error into a resurvey ranking.

invocation.agent_rule: Invoke for bounded restoration resurvey or model-learning questions. Do not describe large residuals as poor restoration outcomes.

limitations: This prioritises learning at existing plots; it does not extrapolate recovery across the whole plateau.
The comparison is predictive and descriptive, not a causal estimate of restoration treatment.
Plots in the same named landscape are withheld together, but landscapes may still differ in unmeasured ways.

recipes.title: Large fruiting trees worth checking and protecting
recipes.decision: Locate individually verified mature native trees that support seed collection or animal visitation.
questions: Which mother trees should we protect?
Where could we collect seed without narrowing genetic diversity?

required_inputs.description: Tree height, girth, species, dispersal traits and visitation evidence.
Georeferenced stems or crowns accurate enough to match an individual canopy crown.
Two co-registered, dated high-resolution canopy-height surfaces for hindcasting crown persistence and emergence.

product.modelled: Upper-canopy crown candidates matched to verified stems.
product.decision_output: Trees for protection or seed-collection checks, with genetic and phenology caveats.

validation.method: Withhold positioned field trees and test crown detection, height error and repeated crown identity.
validation.claim_if_passed: Highlight candidate upper-canopy trees for field confirmation.
validation.claim_if_failed: Remain at plot-level tree evidence and do not name individual crowns.

invocation.agent_rule: Return the missing crown-registration requirements; use plot-level tree maps in the meantime.

limitations: A plot centroid cannot validate an individual crown.
A newly visible crown is not automatically a newly recruited tree.

recipes.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit through the year
recipes.decision: Choose when and where to revisit trees for fruit, seed, flowering or animal-resource monitoring.
questions: When should we revisit these trails for seed or hornbill food trees?

required_inputs.description: Tree-numbered leaf, flower and fruit scores from hand-completed trail forms.
Enough visits to the same tree identities across the seasonal cycle, with blanks distinguished from zero.
Rain and temperature series used as explanatory context rather than phenology labels.

product.observed: Dated tree and trail phenophase scores.
product.modelled: A cyclic seasonal curve only after repeated-tree validation.
product.decision_output: Dates and trails for a bounded revisit or seed-collection check.

validation.method: Fit earlier dates and trees, then predict withheld later visits and withheld trees.
validation.claim_if_passed: Show a seasonal timing estimate with uncertainty and observation coverage.
validation.claim_if_failed: Show dated snapshots only; do not call satellite greenness flowering or fruiting.

invocation.agent_rule: Use only the observed snapshot until repeated forms are admitted and checked.

limitations: The currently inspected phenology PDF contains two trail visits, not a full annual series.
Satellite greenness is explanatory context, not proof of flowering or fruiting.

recipes.title: Where another recorder will add the most information
recipes.decision: Place a limited number of acoustic recorders where they test an explicit uncertainty or under-sampled environmental condition.
questions: Where should we put five recorders?
Which restoration conditions are missing from the soundscape survey?

required_inputs.description: Validated station-level acoustic and bird-detection summaries with recorder effort.
Environmental surfaces from the acoustic survey period, not only a later annual composite.
Whole-station holdouts testing whether the proposed model predicts acoustic outcomes better than a baseline.

product.observed: Recorder stations, effort and validated summaries.
product.modelled: Uncertainty or expected information gain across environmentally supported cells.
product.decision_output: Budget-sized recorder locations that test the largest supported uncertainty.

validation.method: Withhold whole recorder stations and compare prediction and uncertainty calibration against a simple baseline.
validation.claim_if_passed: Recommend new recorder cells inside the environmental support of the training stations.
validation.claim_if_failed: Map existing station coverage and environmental gaps only.

invocation.agent_rule: Do not recommend new stations from environmental novelty alone; wait for the station-level outcome hindcast.

limitations: Environmental novelty is not automatically biodiversity value.
Recorder outages and unequal duration must remain visible.

recipes.title: Connections animals may use—and where to test them
recipes.decision: Choose candidate crossing or movement locations for cameras, canopy checks or other validation.
questions: Where might canopy connections matter for this species?
Where should we verify a possible corridor?

required_inputs.description: Canopy, land cover, roads, streams, settlements and topography.
Crossings, telemetry, camera sequences or another defensible movement response.
Movement observations withheld from resistance fitting.

product.modelled: Species-specific permeability and several plausible routes.
product.decision_output: Locations where a bounded validation deployment most clearly discriminates among routes.

validation.method: Withhold crossings or movement tracks and test whether they occur more often in predicted high-permeability areas than matched alternatives.
validation.claim_if_passed: Show plausible connections and targeted validation locations.
validation.claim_if_failed: Show landscape structure but do not call it a corridor.

invocation.agent_rule: Require a named subject and movement evidence; occurrence proximity alone is not a corridor.

limitations: Occurrence points are not movement paths.

recipes.title: Where an invasive front should be checked next
recipes.decision: Allocate repeat surveys where an observed invasive extent and a tested spread model disagree or remain uncertain.
questions: Where should we check before control work?

required_inputs.description: Presence or abundance with explicit survey effort and repeat dates.
Road, edge, canopy, disturbance and land-cover context.
A later survey wave used only to test the predicted front.

product.decision_output: Survey cells that most reduce uncertainty before treatment.

validation.method: Fit records up to one date and predict the next independent survey wave with effort-aware evaluation.
validation.claim_if_passed: Show a probable front and survey priorities.
validation.claim_if_failed: Show only observed presence and where repeat surveys are absent.

invocation.agent_rule: Do not infer spread from a one-date distribution.

limitations: A spatial pattern from one survey is not a spreading front.
